text: How to set is habit pass or fail?
author: Nikola Marinković
developer_reply:
Hi Nikola,

You have 2 options to pass a habit:
- swipe left to right to mark it as done
- swipe right to left to skip it without affecting you streak.
If you don’t complete you habit it will automatically fail at midnight. However if you forget to mark it you can always return to that day and update the status.

Hope this helps and happy swiping!
